findings.F1: In agitated markets (the coin's 30-day swing above its median), the next day's excess return leans against today's return scaled by the 30-day swing: −0.61 % per unit, t −2.76 (day-clustered, 3,627 bars). In calm markets the slope is only −0.11 %, t −0.80 (3,622 bars). The slope is negative on all 6 coins (BTC t −2.94, ETH −3.01, XMR −3.54, ZEC −1.88, LTC −1.42, XRP −0.71) and in 11 of the 12 windows.
findings.F2: The agitated-market reversal is carried by falls. In the lowest decile of scaled daily return (mean −1.69 swings), the next day's excess is +1.90 %, t 2.65, 343 bars. Deciles 1 to 4 decline steadily (+0.48, +0.19, +0.16, +0.03 %). The highest decile (mean +1.88 swings) gives only −0.14 %, t −0.31. Over all markets, days below −2 swings are followed by +1.91 %, t 2.12, 166 bars.
findings.F3: On the close-location side, the brief's long half holds and the tested short half does not. Low close × width predicts the next day with slope +0.92 %, t 2.88 (7,321 bars). High close × width gives −0.30 %, t −1.23. Wide days closing in the lowest fifth of their range gain +1.23 % the next day, t 2.67, 426 bars, and that mean is positive in 11 of the 12 windows (w12 −0.02 %). Wide days closing in the top fifth give −0.27 %, t −0.78, 643 bars.
findings.F4: The book's gain came from its long side. Longs earned +0.031 % per bar over 3,977 bars, against −0.001 % on 4,179 short bars. In agitated markets longs earned +0.050 % per bar (1,747 bars), against +0.017 % in calm ones. The short side lost −0.017 % per bar in calm markets. Overall, the book's Sharpe was −0.29.
findings.F5: Within agitated down days, the close's place in the range adds little once the fall's size is known: slope −0.020, t −1.51, 1,795 bars. The size of the fall, more than the close location, carries the rebound.

ideas.idea: The lower a coin closes in its day's high-low range, and the wider that day's range is against the coin's usual daily range over the past 30 days, the larger its rise over the next day.
ideas.consequence: A close pinned near the low of an unusually wide day is a reason to buy for the next day, while the mirror short on high closes is not.
ideas.name: wide-day low-close rebound

ideas.idea: In an agitated market, the larger a coin's one-day fall against its usual daily move over the past 30 days, the larger its rise over the next day.
ideas.consequence: After an outsized daily fall in a coin that has been swinging more than usual, a trader buys for a next-day rebound sized by the fall, instead of selling into it.
ideas.name: agitated large-fall next-day rebound

ideas.idea: In an agitated market, the larger a coin's one-day move against its usual daily move over the past 30 days, the larger its move the opposite way over the next day.
ideas.consequence: In a coin swinging more than usual, a trader fades the day's move, sized by its size, for the next day.
ideas.name: agitated daily move reversal
